analysis: linear_cv_attnpath's decomposition on PBC, read by the five linear_unseen readouts
cells: every labelled cell of each scored fold, each read by all five linear_unseen readouts
regions: linear_cv_regions.region_masks; patch writes split by pixel fraction, and as a check by interior patches only, with boundary patches as their own group
measured_region_leads: the measured region's share is the largest of nucleus, cytoplasm and rest; N:C: nucleus and cytoplasm both exceed rest; counted on the mean shares
statistic: Cov(T_g, Y) / Var(Y) over cells, Y = w'(z - beta), as linear_cv_attnpath.py
aggregation: mean and sd (ddof=1) over the 5 readouts
maps: one cell per cell type and scored fold, pandas sample(1, random_state=0); per patch the direct-attention write summed over the 12 blocks, averaged over the 5 readouts
